scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

DB.description: D1 database for users, libraries and tokens. Its migrations run on every deploy.

BLOBS.description: R2 bucket for attachments (`blobs/<sha256>`), nightly exports (`exports/`) and restore records (`restores/`).

OAUTH_KV.description: KV namespace for OAuth clients and grants, used when MCP apps such as claude.ai connect.

LIBRARY.description: One SQLite-backed Durable Object per library: its files, ledger and indexes.

EXPORT_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Nightly exports older than this many days are deleted; the newest is always kept.
